clues: This city in northern Chile lies by a river. It sits far north of Santiago.
The Atacama Desert wraps all around this town. It gets almost no rain in a whole year.
This place was founded on 8 December 1744. Since then it has grown into a city and commune.
The river here ran dry in this new century. Harsh droughts and a changing climate dried it out.
This city is the capital of the Atacama Region. It leads its whole wide province too.
